Country.title: Country
Country.description: Country option with ISO or custom flag displayed in the IndoXDPro homepage selector and managed by admins.

countryId.description: Unique identifier for the country record.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for preset flags, or empty string for uploaded flags.

flagDataUrl.description: Base64 data URL for uploaded custom flag.

isActive.description: Whether the country appears in the public homepage dropdown.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who created the country.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the country was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the country was last updated.

VpnServer.title: VpnServer
VpnServer.description: A country-specific VPN server entry managed by an administrator.

countryName.description: Display name of the VPN country.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for built-in SVG flags, or empty string when using a custom uploaded flag.

flagMode.description: Indicates whether the flag uses a preset ISO code or a custom uploaded image.

flagDataUrl.description: Base64 data URL for a custom uploaded flag image.

ipAddress.description: IPv4, IPv6, or endpoint address of the VPN server.

ipCode.description: Access code or node identifier associated with the IP address.

status.description: Operational state of the VPN server.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who created this entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the VPN entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the VPN entry was last updated.

RedeemCode.title: RedeemCode
RedeemCode.description: Admin-managed redeem code with rupee balance, status, expiry date, and atomic redemption state.

codeId.description: Deterministic identifier for the redeem code record.

balance.description: Monetary balance associated with this redeem code in INR.

status.description: Administrative status of the redeem code.

expiryDate.description: Optional expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) or empty string if no expiry.

redemptionStatus.description: Tracks whether the code has been redeemed.

redeemedAt.description: ISO timestamp when redeemed, or empty string if unused.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who created the code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the redeem code was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the redeem code was last updated.

IpCode.title: IpCode
IpCode.description: Admin-managed IP Code entries used to verify user VPN connections.

codeId.description: Deterministic base64url identifier for the IP Code record.

code.description: IP Code string created by an administrator.

label.description: Optional note or label for this IP Code.

status.description: Operational state of the IP Code.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who created the IP Code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the IP Code was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the IP Code was last updated.

ConnectionRequest.title: ConnectionRequest
ConnectionRequest.description: Audit log of VPN connection submissions verified against Firestore IP Codes and Redeem Codes.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the connection request log.

redeemCodeId.description: Document ID of the redeem code checked.

ipCodeId.description: Document ID of the IP code checked.

balance.description: Authoritative INR balance redeemed on successful connection (0 if rejected).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was submitted.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator profile granting access to manage IndoXDPro Firestore collections (zero passwords stored).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authorized admin.

email.description: Verified Firebase Auth email address of the authorized admin.

adminId.description: Authorized Admin ID assigned to this administrator (e.g., ADMIN551).

displayName.description: Display name or title for the administrator.

isActive.description: Whether this administrator profile is currently active.

addedBy.description: UID of the administrator who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin profile was last updated.

AdminIdMapping.title: AdminIdMapping
AdminIdMapping.description: Maps an authorized Admin ID (e.g., ADMIN551) to its Firebase Authentication email account without storing any password.

idKey.description: Normalized lowercase Admin ID key used as the Firestore document ID.

authEmail.description: Firebase Authentication Email/Password account email mapped to this Admin ID.

uid.description: Linked Firebase Auth UID once signed in or configured.

isActive.description: Whether login using this Admin ID is enabled.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who saved this mapping.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this Admin ID mapping was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this Admin ID mapping was last updated.

/countries/{countryId}.description: Selectable VPN portal countries with flags, managed by admins.

/vpn_servers/{serverId}.description: Private admin-managed VPN server entries and optional credentials.

/redeem_codes/{codeId}.description: Admin-managed redeem codes with INR balance, expiry cutoff, and atomic transaction redemption.

/ip_codes/{ipCodeId}.description: Admin-managed IP Codes required for VPN connection verification.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Protected registry of authorized administrator profiles and UIDs.

/admin_ids/{adminIdKey}.description: Exact-ID lookup mapping configured Admin IDs to their Firebase Auth email accounts.
